statements.query: MATCH (n:GCPBucket{exposed_internet:true})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE n.exposed_internet, n.exposed_internet_type return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: An IAM binding (any role) to allUsers / allAuthenticatedUsers makes the bucket public, unless public access prevention is enforced on the bucket: then such grants have no effect. A prevention enforced only by the org policy shows as 'inherited' and is not known here, so the bucket stays public (fail-safe).
statements.query:
MATCH (binding:GCPBucketPolicyBinding)<-[:ATTACHED_BINDING]-(bucket:GCPBucket)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})
WHERE coalesce(bucket.public_access_prevention, '') <> 'enforced'
UNWIND [m IN binding.members WHERE m IN ['allUsers', 'allAuthenticatedUsers']] AS member
SET bucket.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT member IN coalesce(bucket.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN bucket END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(bucket.exposed_internet_type, []) + member

statements.__comment: A legacy bucket or default object ACL entry for allUsers / allAuthenticatedUsers makes the bucket public when ACLs are in force (uniform bucket-level access off) and public access prevention is not enforced on the bucket.
statements.query:
MATCH (bucket:GCPBucket)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})
WHERE size(coalesce(bucket.public_acl_entities, [])) > 0 AND coalesce(bucket.uniform_bucket_level_access, false) = false AND coalesce(bucket.public_access_prevention, '') <> 'enforced'
UNWIND bucket.public_acl_entities AS member
SET bucket.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT member IN coalesce(bucket.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN bucket END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(bucket.exposed_internet_type, []) + member
